nautilus-dropbox on Omarchy

Brings Dropbox's sync status and sharing menu right into your file manager.

It is a 73.5 KB download (113.5 KB installed), version 2026.09.28-1, licensed CC-BY-ND-3.0 AND GPL-3.0-or-later. Dropbox Nautilus Extension. Install nautilus-dropbox on Omarchy

This package integrates the Dropbox desktop client with the GNOME Files (Nautilus) file manager, adding sync-status overlay icons and right-click context menu options (like Share Dropbox Link) directly in your normal file browsing. It requires the separate Dropbox daemon to actually be installed and running, and a Dropbox account to sign in and sync files.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add nautilus-dropbox
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 2026.09.28-1:
    pacman -Qi nautilus-dropbox

Open and use nautilus-dropbox

nautilus-dropbox is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql nautilus-dropbox | grep applications

nautilus-dropbox requirements and compatibility

  • A Dropbox account (sign up/log in)
  • The Dropbox sync daemon installed and running
  • Network access to sync files

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • nautilus
  • libnautilus-extension
  • dropbox

Frequently asked questions

How do I install nautilus-dropbox on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add nautilus-dropbox. The download is 73.5 KB and it takes 113.5 KB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is nautilus-dropbox free?

Free tier + paid Plus/Professional/Business/Enterprise plans. The package is licensed CC-BY-ND-3.0 AND GPL-3.0-or-later.

How do I uninstall nautilus-dropbox?

Run omarchy pkg drop nautilus-dropbox. It removes the package from your system.

What does nautilus-dropbox depend on?

The package declares 3 dependencies: nautilus, libnautilus-extension, dropbox. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is nautilus-dropbox a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for nautilus-dropbox.

Is nautilus-dropbox in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as nautilus-dropbox (version 2026.09.28-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Dropbox makes it. Project site: https://www.dropbox.com/.
